scope: York County, Pennsylvania incorporated municipalities and USGS GNIS Populated Place records only. Named places are geographic labels, not presumed governments; they inherit the governing municipality selected by a point-in-polygon join to the York County Planning Commission municipal boundary layer. Configured coverage means at least one reviewed body source, not that every board or every historical file is retrievable. The GNIS point identifies a municipality, not the full extent of a named community; informal names outside GNIS are not claimed complete.
